blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY — A simple celebration will mark the installation of Bishop Crispin “Bai” Barrete Varquez as the eighth bishop of the Diocese of Tagbilaran at 9 a.m. Tuesday, Oct. 27, at the St. Joseph the Worker Cathedral-Shrine. Varquez, 65, requested a low-key ceremony without elaborate displays, including decorative flags along the streets. A native of Sevilla, Bohol, he is returning to his home province after 19 years as bishop of the Diocese of Borongan in Eastern Samar.
